def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    t = int(data[1])
    a = list(map(int, data[2:]))
    
    row_count = [0] * n
    col_count = [0] * n
    diag1_count = 0
    diag2_count = 0
    
    ans = -1
    for l in range(t):
        ai = a[l]
        i = (ai - 1) // n
        j = (ai - 1) % n
        
        row_count[i] += 1
        col_count[j] += 1
        
        if i == j:
            diag1_count += 1
        if i + j == n - 1:
            diag2_count += 1
        
        if (row_count[i] == n or col_count[j] == n or 
            diag1_count == n or diag2_count == n):
            ans = l + 1
            break
    
    print(ans)
